source.snippet: Feature Request: Let administrators define a default home page per user group: which widgets are shown, which workboard tiles are visible, and optionally the landing page after login. Use case: teams need different home pages — sales team sees pipeline tiles, warehouse team sees stock alerts, accountants see invoices due.

problem_statement: Open-source ERP admins cannot configure role-based dashboard layouts, forcing all user groups to share the same home page and reducing operational efficiency for multi-department businesses.
target_segment: SMB operations managers and IT admins using open-source ERP systems (e.g., Dolibarr) with multi-department teams
notes: Business buyer: ERP admins at companies with distinct departmental workflows. The gap between global and per-user config (no group-level middle tier) is a real operational pain. A paid plugin or hosted ERP layer solving this could command $29-99/mo. Prior related issue closed as stale signals repeated unmet demand.
